name: Displacement of Water
source:
In preparation for the day Harmonica would eventually do wrong, she has spent her entire life accumulating moral wealth in the form of silver coins. But well into adulthood and still having not committed a single sin, she develops a desire to spend it all on but a single prize: to feel the life drain out of a particular woman.

[From [url=https://sopy.itch.io/displacement-of-water]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
为了准备口琴最终犯错的那一天，她一生都在以银币的形式积累道德财富。但到了成年后，她仍然没有犯下任何罪过，她产生了一种渴望，要把所有的钱都花在一个奖品上：感受某个特定女人的生命耗尽。

[来自[url=https://sopy.itch.io/displacement-of-water]itch.io[/url]]
